programs.title: Some Other Woman
programs.desc: Eve sees a strange woman watching her and her husband from outside their home. As the stranger slowly intrudes further into their lives, Eve begins to question if she's losing her mind or her husband's loyalty.

programs.title: Rise of the Footsoldier: Vengeance
programs.desc: Pat Tate sets out on a rampage to avenge his trusted foot soldier's violent death, going beyond his comfort zone of Essex and into the dark side of 1990s Soho to track down the villain responsible. He squares up against violent kingpins and negotiates his way through treacherous backstreets. Tate will stop at nothing to enact his revenge, even as the world around him starts to explode.

programs.title: Targeted for Murder
programs.desc: When Jennifer Cave fails to show up at her new job, her family fears the worst; their fears are confirmed when they take their search for her into their own hands.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: Police brings in Sergeant Jeffrey Pelo for questioning after being identified prowling outside a young woman's house in the middle of the night; adamant he's done nothing wrong, interrogators walk a tight rope questioning one of their own.

programs.title: One Way Mirror
programs.desc: A confession to a lesser crime is still a false confession; when Nick Nehring admits to gunning down a man, claims of self-defense set him up for a shorter sentence; getting the true story could mean the difference of year.

programs.title: The Hands That Feed Us
programs.desc: Exploring the challenges of making a living as a modern Canadian farmer; how they sell their food and how little control they have over the process and price; from small scale to massive debt; from farmer's markets to supply chain.
